name: Hello Lady!
source:
It's the Dawn of a New Age.

The 21st century has brought about its own slew of problems for society at large. As a result, the most promising youths from around the world have been gathered and enrolled in Tenkawa Noble Academy. The curriculum at The Academy is designed to teach students how to use their talents to lead humanity toward a brighter future.

Standing at the apex of Tenkawa Noble Academy are five beautiful young girls known as "Crowns."

One day, the leader of the Crowns, Saku Otonashi, is targeted in a terrorist incident. And on that occasion, her life is saved by the sudden and unexpected appearance of a young and quite eccentric man.

"It can't be... A sixth, and a boy, at that...?"
"Hello there, Saku Otonashi. My name is Shinri Narita."

By some stroke of luck, the young man is a transfer student. Not only that, but he's also the sixth Crown.

However...
Shinri Narita immediately finds fault with The Academy's current system.

"In the name of my will, I shall do what must be done and bring about change to this little garden of knowledge."
"In the name of the Crowns, I, Saku Otonashi, declare that Shinri Narita must be stopped!"

And so, the winds of fortune begin to blow restlessly through The Academy, changing the prideful girls' futures in ways they could never have imagined...

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1751630/Hello_Lady__Complete_Edition/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
新时代的黎明已经到来。

进入21世纪，社会面临着一连串新的问题。因此，来自世界各地、最具潜力的年轻人被召集起来，进入天河至尊学园学习。学园的课程旨在教导学生运用自身的才能，引领人类迈向更加光明的未来。

站在天河至尊学园顶点的，是被称为“皇冠”的五位美丽少女。

一天，皇冠的领袖音无朔成为恐怖袭击的目标。一位年轻而古怪的男子出人意料地突然出现，救下了她。

“不可能…第六位，而且还是男生…？”
“你好，音无朔。我叫成田真理。”

机缘巧合之下，这位青年以转学生的身份来到学园。不仅如此，他还是第六位皇冠。

然而…
成田真理立刻对学园现行的体制提出了异议。

“以我的意志之名，我将做应做之事，改变这座小小的知识庭园。”
“以皇冠之名，我，音无朔，在此宣告：必须阻止成田真理！”

于是，命运的风开始在学园里躁动，令这些骄傲少女的未来发生了她们从未想象过的变化…

[编译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1751630/Hello_Lady__Complete_Edition/]Steam[/url]]
